_comment: Schema 1. Copy, fill and save as the path `extract.py path <key>` prints. null = the source does not state it; never fill from memory. A value the source plainly implies but does not state starts with 'inferred: '. Numbers keep their unit as printed ('3e-4', '7B', '2048 tokens', '8x A100 80GB'). One result per number: split a claim with several. Keys starting with _ are guidance and may be dropped.

read.skipped: <what was not read and why, or null>

type: <empirical | survey | benchmark | system | theory | position | book-chapter>
question: <one sentence: the problem the work sets out to answer>
hypothesis: <the stated or plainly implied expectation, or null>

method._comment: Required for empirical, system and benchmark. Put every number the paper gives; a field it does not give is null. `trains` says whether the work trains or fine-tunes anything: when false, the training block stays null and the reproducibility score counts the inference and eval fields instead. `other` holds anything that matters for a rerun and has no slot.
method.summary: <two or three sentences: what was built or done>
method.task: <e.g. open-domain QA, next-token pretraining, preference optimisation>

datasets.name: <name>
datasets.source: <where it comes from, licence if stated>

models.name: <name>
models.role: <proposed | evaluated | baseline | base | teacher | judge | retriever | reward>

inference.samples: <samples per item, runs or seeds, e.g. '32 samples, Pass@1 averaged'>
inference.prompting: <prompt format, few-shot k, system prompt, or null>

parameters._comment: method-specific settings that are not training hyperparameters, e.g. a decoding penalty's alpha and beta

eval.protocol: <runs, seeds, significance test, human or model judge, or null>

evidence.quote: <optional verbatim text the value comes from>

results.kind: <measured (this work's own experiment) | reported (quoted from other work) | worked-example | claim>
results.source: <for kind reported: the work it is quoted from, as cited, or null>
results.setup: <dataset, model, scale, conditions it holds under>
results.quote: <verbatim, required when value is set unless `table` is>
results.table: <for a number read from a table: 'Table 3, row DeepSeek-R1 + prompt, column Pass@1'; its numbers must occur in the text>
results.note: <inconsistencies in the paper, e.g. the same number printed differently in two places, or null>

limits: <what it does not show, what the authors concede, what has dated>
practices: <book chapters and surveys: each recommendation as one sentence, with where; [] otherwise>

lineage.relation: <extends | replicates | contradicts | baseline | evaluates | uses-method | uses-data | surveys | related>
